svg.text: Archimedes-Type Helical Blade Unit – Vertical Axis
Archimedes-type helical rotor, vertical axis – option A, 1000 mm diameter
INDICATIVE ARTIST'S ILLUSTRATION – NOT TO SCALE
Dimensions to be confirmed by survey and detailed design
Commercially available Archimedes-type helical rotor, but up-graded from wind duty for heavy-duty use in water.
Option A of two issued for selection: option A is 1 000 mm diameter, option B is 1 500 mm diameter. Both are 3 500 mm deep on a vertical axis.
Vertical axis: the shaft runs straight up through the deck into the AFE Pod. No right-angle bevel drive is required, which removes a gear box from every unit.
Blade: 6 mm marine grade stainless or GRP flight, continuously welded or bonded to the shaft; leading edge radiused to shed weed and line.
Bearings: upper thrust bearing carried on the sub-frame beam, lower guide bearing on the unit frame. Both water lubricated and free of oil seals.
Materials, blade thickness and bearing selection are indicative and to be confirmed by the supplier for the site flow velocity.
